welcomeText: Experience the relaxed spirit of Linderhof Country Club in Glen, New Hampshire — a place to enjoy the course, gather with friends and celebrate life in the valley.

membershipNote: The official 2027 membership guide governs rates, eligibility, discounts and policies.
lpoaAbout: Chartered in 1978, the Linderhof Property Owners Association (LPOA) is a domestic non-profit corporation comprised of the owners of condominiums in the Linderhof Country Club area.
lpoaArea: The area is located in the heart of the White Mountains in Mount Washington Valley. It is a most sought after location for year round vacationing and relaxation offering first class skiing, golfing, hiking, mountain climbing, water kayaking and rafting, and shopping.
